jobs.description:
Company Description
  
Purpose Unlimited is an independent financial services company with an unrelenting focus on customer\-centric innovation, delivered through technology\-driven solutions. Led by entrepreneur Som Seif, the company is developing a diversified product platform aimed at addressing historically underserved segments of the market. Purpose Unlimited’s businesses include Purpose Investments, Advisor Solutions by Purpose, and Driven.
  
  

Who is Advisor Solutions by Purpose?
  
Advisor Solutions by Purpose, a subsidiary of Purpose Unlimited, is an innovative financial technology firm providing modern client and practice management technology and services for independent portfolio management and financial advisory businesses in Canada. Recognized by Wealth Professional Magazine as 2023 Wealth Tech Service Provider of the Year and one of Canada’s Top 2023 Small and Medium Employers, Advisor Solutions by Purpose’s end\-to\-end solution simplifies the advisor practice and makes it easier for clients to access better services to achieve their financial goals. For more information, please visit https://www.purposeadvisors.com
  
**Vacancy Status:** This is for a current opening.
  
**Compensation:** $140,000 \- $180,000
  
Job Description
  
The Opportunity
  
Advisors across Canada are rethinking how they build their practices. The tools are better. The expectations are higher. The old platform models are showing their age. Purpose Unlimited is building the alternative – an advisor platform that combines investment product manufacturing, practice management intelligence, and AI\-powered support into something genuinely useful.
  
  

Who You are
  
We are looking for a VP, Advisor Development Sales to lead advisor acquisition for our Advisor Solutions Platform. This is not a role where you manage a pipeline and wait for inbound. You will be the person who finds the right advisors, earns their trust, helps them see what their practice could become on Purpose’s platform, and brings them in.
  
You will own the full advisor acquisition lifecycle – from strategic prospecting through to close – and you will do it with AI tools that handle the routine so you can focus on what actually wins deals: relationships, judgment, and the ability to help an advisor envision something better.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

What You Will Deliver
  
* Drive net new advisor acquisition revenue, converting high\-potential advisors to the Purpose platform through consultative, trust\-based engagement
* Build and execute a strategic acquisition plan targeting specific advisor segments, geographies, and competitive displacement opportunities across Canada
* Architect complex platform transitions for established advisory practices – navigating compliance, technology migration, book transfers, and change management
* Serve as the strategic voice of the advisor to Purpose’s product, technology, and leadership teams – translating field intelligence into platform improvements that matter
* Develop deep market intelligence on competitive platforms, advisor sentiment, and industry shifts – using AI tools to surface insight and your judgment to act on it
* Deliver practice management consulting to prospects and platform advisors – helping them grow, modernize, and future\-proof their businesses
* Collaborate across product, compliance, marketing, and operations to remove barriers and accelerate advisor onboarding


What AI Does So You Don’t Have To
  
Purpose is an AI\-forward organization. In this role, AI handles:
  
* Prospect research, lead scoring, and prioritization – AI surfaces the highest\-value advisor targets from market and CRM data
* First\-draft proposals, pitch materials, and personalized advisor communications
* Pipeline forecasting, activity tracking, and real\-time competitive intelligence monitoring
* Meeting preparation – advisor profiles, practice analytics, and talking points assembled before every conversation


You direct the AI. You validate the output. You bring the judgment and relationship that no tool can replicate.
  
What Only You Can Do
  
* Build the trust that makes an advisor willing to move their life’s work to a new platform
* Read a room – understand what an advisor is really asking for beneath the surface\-level objection
* Navigate the emotional complexity of a platform transition – fear, inertia, loyalty, ambition
* Structure creative deal terms and partnership models that work for the advisor and for Purpose
* Translate what you hear in the field into product and strategy insight that makes Purpose better

What You Must Bring
  
* Deep experience in advisor\-facing roles within Canadian wealth management – you understand how advisors think, what they value, and what drives their decisions
* A consultative sales approach grounded in trust\-building, not transactional closing – demonstrated track record of complex, multi\-stakeholder advisory transitions
* Strong familiarity with the Canadian advisor landscape – platforms, dealers, regulatory environment, and competitive dynamics
* Comfort working with AI tools as part of your daily workflow – you are already using AI for research, content creation, or sales preparation, or eager to start

* Experience leading advisor transitions from competing platforms – you’ve navigated the compliance, technology, and emotional complexity of moving a book

jobs.title: Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.description:
**Join a Challenger**  

  

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  

  

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.  

  

**What's kept us moving?** The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.  

  

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  

  

We can’t wait to get to know you!

### **Purpose of the Job**



The Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management is a senior member of the CRO’s leadership team and serves as the CRO and Deputy CRO’s primary partner on enterprise risk governance, leading the second\-line ERM function and the continued development and operation of a forward\-looking risk management program aligned with regulatory expectations and commensurate with EQ Bank’s size, scope and complexity.  

  

The VP, ERM will provide the vision and roadmap to further embed ERM across the organization, working closely with business leaders to strengthen risk management capabilities while providing independent oversight and effective challenge on strategic and business decisions. The role will oversee the Bank’s enterprise\-wide view of risk, including its Board\-approved Risk Appetite Framework, management and reporting of key risks, and reporting to the Board and Enterprise Risk Management Committee (ERMC), while supporting the CRO and Deputy CRO in interactions with OSFI and other regulatory stakeholders.  

  

The VP, ERM will also lead the risk management aspects of integration of PC Financial with EQ Bank and build a high\-performing ERM team that is nimble and innovative, enabling EQ Bank to achieve its strategic objectives while operating within its risk appetite.



### **Risk Governance**

* Lead the risk governance program. This covers owning and maintaining EQ Bank’s ERM framework, policy inventory, the annual review cycle, committee charters, escalation protocols, and coordinating policy submissions for ERMC.
* Act as the primary day\-to\-day point of contact with OSFI for the Risk function. Coordinate supervisory meetings, information requests, reviews, and follow\-up questions across the bank.
* Monitor OSFI guidance and regulatory developments affecting risk, capital, and liquidity. Assess their impact, lead the Bank's readiness plans, and promote a strong risk culture through clear accountability and training.
### **Risk Reporting**

* Own the CRO's quarterly reporting to the ERMC and the Board. This covers the enterprise risk dashboard, top and emerging risks, and the risk profile against appetite.
* Run ERMC as its secretariat and content lead. Set agendas, bring together reporting on credit, financial, operational, compliance and strategic risks, and track decisions and actions.
* Turn complex, multi\-risk information into short, decision\-focused insight for both committees. Bring forward material issues, top\-risk assessments, and thematic deep dives so leaders can act early.
* Prepare the CRO and Deputy CRO for committee discussions, and manage the Board risk agenda, follow\-up actions, and the annual risk governance calendar.
* Keep improving the reporting suite through better data, more automation, and a consistent risk taxonomy across the enterprise.
### **Risk Identification \& Assessment \& Risk Appetite Monitoring**

* Lead the annual enterprise\-wide risk assessment. Identify, assess, and rank material and emerging risks with the business lines and second\-line partners, and use the results to set the top\-risk inventory and ICAAP risk coverage.
* Run the annual refresh of the Risk Appetite Framework and Statement. Recalibrate metrics, limits, and early warning indicators to reflect the strategic plan, the financial forecast, stress testing results, and changes in the business, including the PC Financial portfolios.
* Steer the refresh through governance from management review to ERMC endorsement and Board approval. Cascade the approved appetite into business\-line limits and policies.
* Monitor risk appetite metrics against Board and management limits throughout the year. Report position and trends to ERMC and the Board.
* Run the escalation and remediation process for limit breaches and amber trends, including root\-cause analysis and tracking of corrective actions.
### **Risk \- Integration Management Office (IMO) and Convergence for PC Financial**

* Lead the risk workstream of the PC Financial integration. Coordinate second\-line oversight of integration milestones, synergy delivery, and the associated risks.
* Drive the convergence of PC Bank's risk frameworks, policies, limits, reporting, and controls onto EQ Bank's enterprise standards. Make sure combined\-entity reporting is accurate and complete.
* Lead the OSFI reporting related to IMO \& Convergence activities for the entire bank.
### **Let's Talk About You!**

* Minimum of 15 years of experience in a financial institution in a leadership capacity and at least 10 years’ experience in the ERM function leading quantitative teams
* Broad and deep experience in various risk functions, including credit, operational, market, stress testing and IRRBB
* Deep knowledge of OSFI expectations, including Corporate Governance, E\-21, B\-20, CAR, LAR and ICAAP. Direct experience managing supervisory relationships

	+ Guide and influence various stakeholders across the organization to achieve the goals defined in the DAIR and AI Risk Management strategies and programs, including the responsible adoption of emerging AI technologies.

* Act as a thought leader in AI risk governance, representing the organization in various industry forums and panels

* Strong grasp of global and regional AI regulations.
* Curious and proactive and agile learner interested in new technology, ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic risk management best practices, trends and developments in data and AI governance.

jobs.description:
A profitable DTC pet brand is looking for a Head of Retention \& Customer Experience to join our team! You will own everything after the first order: subscriptions, email and SMS, the post\-purchase journey and customer experience, across both of our brands.


We're doing $50M\+ a year and scaling to $100M\+, and we want one senior leader who owns retention A\-Z: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value and a better customer experience across the board. We are looking to hire someone with 5\-6\+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, who has led retention at a subscription brand doing $30\-50M\+ a year (ideally nine figures). The ideal candidate is hands\-on in Klaviyo and Loop (or similar), has led a retention and customer experience team, and has managed agencies.

**The mission of this role**


Own retention A\-Z to fuel the growth to 9\-figures. This role comes in to drive three things: lower churn, significantly higher lifetime value, and a better customer experience across the board. Success is lower churn, stronger retention, much higher lifetime value, more revenue from email and SMS, and happier customers.

**Who are we?**


We are a profitable DTC brand selling premium pet products. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest\-growing brands in the pet space – $50M\+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M\+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into a new customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

**What is our culture like \& who is a good fit?**


Culture\-fit is our \#1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will\-to\-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday:** have a retention test live every week across subscriptions, flows or the post\-purchase experience, and write down what each result teaches.
* **Speed Is King:** spot a churn, refund or CSAT problem the day it shows up and have a fix in motion that week.
* **Work Smart:** AI and automation first. Claude reads cancellation reasons, reviews and tickets to find why customers leave, AI drafts flow copy and segments, and retention KPIs report themselves every week.
* **Overdeliver:** bring the CEO the next big retention lever before being asked, and get more lifetime value from every customer than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress\-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**


If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast\-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M\+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands\-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

**Outcomes (what success looks like)**


90\-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.

* Churn goes down: monthly subscription churn and save rate, by brand
* Retention improves: repeat purchase rate and cohort retention at 3, 6 and 12 months
* Lifetime value rises significantly: 12\-month lifetime value by cohort and brand vs the same cohorts last year
* Email and SMS drive more revenue: email and SMS share of total revenue, and revenue per recipient
* Customers are happier across the board: CSAT, review rating, refund rate and tickets per order

**Key Objectives**

* Own the subscription program for both brands: offers, cadence, bundles, the customer portal and the cancellation flow.
* Build and test save offers, skip, swap and pause options, and win\-back flows to cut churn.
* Own email and SMS strategy for both brands, and manage the retention agency's calendar, flows, targets and results.
* Build the lifecycle journey from first order to loyal customer: welcome, post\-purchase, replenishment, cross\-sell, win\-back and VIP flows.
* Map and improve the full post\-purchase journey, and run a loyalty, referral or VIP program if the numbers support it.
* Lead the customer experience team and set customer service policy that protects both the customer and the margin.
* Report cohort retention and lifetime value against target every month, and name the biggest lever.

  

**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, based outside the US.
* Fluent in English.
* Retention Leadership: 5\-6\+ years in retention or lifecycle at DTC brands, including leading retention at a subscription brand doing $30\-50M\+ a year (ideally nine figures). This is a must.
* Subscription Expertise: you have grown a subscription program and know churn, saves, cohorts and MRR inside out.
* Lifecycle Marketing: you build email and SMS programs (Klaviyo or similar) that drive a large share of revenue without burning the list.
* Tools: deep hands\-on experience with Klaviyo (or similar) and Loop (or a similar subscription platform).
* Analytical: you read cohort, lifetime value and churn data fast and find the lever that moves the number.
* Testing Discipline: you run clear tests on offers, flows and save tactics, and read results honestly.
* Leadership: you have led a retention and customer experience team, including managing agencies, through KPIs and goals.
* Commercial Judgement: you protect margin, and know when a discount or save offer earns its cost.

jobs.description:
At Gore Mutual, we've always set ourselves apart as a modern mutual that does good. Now, we're proudly building on that legacy to transform our company—and our industry—for the better.



Effective January 1, 2026, Gore has joined Beneva—the country's largest mutual insurance company—as part of its Property \& Casualty operations in Ontario and Western Canada. During 2026, Gore will combine its operations with Unica Insurance, Beneva's Ontario\-based subsidiary specializing in niche commercial and personal insurance, creating a stronger, more diversified mutual insurer with greater scale and long\-term stability.



Every decision and investment remains anchored in long\-term benefits to customers, members, and communities. Come join us.


We are looking for a Director, Data Engineering to lead a critical capability within Gore's Enterprise Data \& Analytics organization. You will lead the teams responsible for turning enterprise data into trusted, reusable data products and building the engineering capabilities that enable Data, Insights and AI across Gore.



You will shape how we build and manage data products, evolve our Data Engineering and MLOps capabilities, and ensure our Databricks and Azure ecosystem provides the foundation needed for Analytics, Data Science, GenAI and emerging AI solutions.



This is a visible leadership role for someone who combines strong technical depth with business understanding, people leadership and the ability to turn data and technology investments into meaningful business outcomes.


**What will you do?**


**Build Enterprise Data Products**


* Lead the development of trusted, reusable data products that combine business meaning, data quality and strong engineering to support operational, analytical, Data Science and AI use cases.
* Establish and mature our data product discipline, partnering with business and technology leaders to turn high\-value data needs into scalable capabilities.
* Improve the accessibility, consistency and value of enterprise data while reducing fragmentation and duplication.


**Advance Data Engineering \& AI Enablement**


* Lead and mature Data Engineering and MLOps capabilities, creating repeatable paths to move data, machine learning, GenAI and emerging AI solutions into secure, reliable production.
* Raise engineering standards across integration, APIs, orchestration, CI/CD, testing, observability, automation, data quality and production operations.
* Partner across Data, Analytics and technology teams to provide the engineering capabilities needed to scale Data Science and AI.


**Evolve Our Data Technology Foundation**


* Guide the evolution of Gore's Databricks and Azure ecosystem to provide a scalable, resilient, secure and cost\-effective foundation for Data, Insights and AI.
* Partner with IT and Architecture to shape architecture patterns, integration approaches and technology standards.
* Evaluate emerging Data and AI technologies based on business value, scalability, security and long\-term sustainability.


**Build and Lead a Strong Engineering Organization**


* Lead, coach and develop high\-performing teams across Data Products, Data Platforms, Data Engineering and MLOps.
* Develop strong managers and technical leaders with clear accountability for products, engineering quality and production outcomes.
* Build a culture of ownership, curiosity, continuous improvement and engineering excellence.


**Provide Visible Enterprise Leadership**


* Represent Data Engineering with senior business and technology leaders, vendors and strategic partners.
* Translate complex technology decisions into clear business implications, trade\-offs, risks and recommendations.
* Provide clear leadership across priorities, investments, delivery and significant operational challenges.


**What will you need to succeed?**


* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience
* Significant leadership experience across Data Engineering, data products, data platforms, MLOps or related enterprise technology functions.
* Proven experience building enterprise data products and translating business needs into reusable, scalable data capabilities.
* Proven experience building and operating enterprise\-scale data platforms and production data workloads.
* Direct production experience with Databricks, including data engineering, lakehouse architecture, governance and optimization.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and modern cloud data architectures.
* Strong technical knowledge of Python, SQL, APIs, data integration, orchestration and distributed processing.
* Experience with technologies such as Delta Lake, Unity Catalog and MLflow, or comparable capabilities.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, DevOps, DataOps and modern production engineering practices.
* Practical MLOps experience enabling Data Science, machine learning and AI workloads in production.
* Experience enabling GenAI or emerging AI capabilities in secure enterprise environments.
* A strong track record of coaching and developing engineers, managers and technical leaders.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior business, technology and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Director of Solution Architecture
jobs.description:
At PwC Canada, we're transforming the way we work—and the way our people and clients experience technology. Our Products \& Technology team builds the digital products, enterprise applications, and AI\-enabled platforms that power the firm and shape the future of professional services. We're a community of solvers combining technology, data, and human ingenuity to deliver sustained outcomes that matter. We're looking for a Director of Solution Architecture to lead our established team of Senior Solution Architects—a technically deep, business\-savvy leader who can set direction, grow and develop talent, and partner with senior leaders across the firm to turn ambitious ideas into reality. Reporting to the Architecture and Development Leader, you will lead PwC Canada's Solution Architecture practice within Products \& Technology. You will take ownership of our established team of Senior Solution Architects, elevate their performance, and grow the team's capabilities as our technology ambitions expand. The team designs AI\-enabled products, enterprise applications, and platforms used across the firm's lines of service, ensuring our solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, aligned with enterprise architecture standards—and deliver real business value. This is a hands\-on architecture leadership role. While your focus is on design and technical direction rather than execution, you'll be expected to understand the technology from the inside. You'll go deep into architecture diagrams, integration designs, data flows, platform configurations, and the realities of how solutions are implemented, engaging with technical trade\-offs at a practitioner level. Your credibility with the team and with stakeholders will come from genuine technical depth and a willingness to go hands\-on with architecture and implementation details when the situation calls for it, not from high\-level concepts alone. Equally, this role operates at the intersection of business and technology. You'll be a trusted advisor to business stakeholders and organizational leaders, translating complex challenges into clear technology solutions, influencing strategic direction, and communicating in terms that resonate with executives. You'll also help shape how PwC Canada adopts emerging technologies, including generative and agentic AI.**The Opportunity**

As a Director of Solution Architecture, unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:


* Provide architecture oversight for digital products, enterprise applications, and AI\-enabled solutions from ideation through production
* Lead solution design decisions, balancing reusable platform components with business\-specific needs
* Guide the architecture of enterprise applications—including SaaS platforms, ERP, CRM, HR, finance, and collaboration systems—ensuring effective integration, extensibility, and alignment with our broader technology ecosystem
* Go hands\-on with architecture and technical implementation details when needed—working through complex integration patterns, data flows, platform configurations, or design problems alongside the team
* Advise on the adoption of emerging technologies, including generative and agentic AI
* Manage, coach, and mentor an established team of talented Senior Solution Architects, elevating performance and fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning
* Grow the team's capabilities over time—identifying skill gaps, developing talent from within, and recruiting new members as the practice expands
* Evolve team structure and define new roles as the practice grows and technology priorities shift
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Data, Security, and Risk teams to ensure solutions align with firm standards
* Participate in architecture review boards and technology governance forums, advising on governance requirements, risk assessments, and policy exceptions
Contribute to PwC's broader architecture community—locally and across the global PwC network  
* 

  

**What You’ll Bring**

Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here’s what we look for:


* Experience in technology roles, including significant time in solution or enterprise architecture, with extensive experience designing and delivering solutions within large, complex organizations
* Proven experience leading, developing, and growing a team of Senior Solution Architects—setting technical direction, elevating performance, and fostering a high\-performance culture, including in an Agile/DevOps environment
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
* Azure Cloud Platform certifications (Solutions Architect or Developer) preferred; TOGAF certification
* Strong technical depth as an architect—able to engage with the technology from the inside, work through implementation\-level details, and go hands\-on with architecture and design when the situation requires it
* Enterprise application architecture, including SaaS and COTS platforms (ERP, CRM, HCM, finance, collaboration, workflow), integration patterns (APIs, iPaaS, event\-driven), and configuration vs. customization trade\-offs
* Cloud\-native architectures on Azure (AWS/GCP nice to have), including containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code
* Generative AI and agentic AI solution design, including LLM integration, RAG patterns, and responsible AI practices
* Enterprise software architecture and design patterns, including service\-oriented, event\-driven, and microservices architectures; data architecture and persistence strategies (RDBMS, NoSQL); and Big Data, analytics, and AI/ML architecture
* Security\-by\-design, privacy, and compliance considerations, plus vendor and product evaluation, including RFP processes, proof\-of\-concepts, and total\-cost\-of\-ownership

YNCU was created by working people and small business owners who pooled their money to make affordable financial services available to one another. They weren’t just customers—they were our founders. That spirit still shapes how we work today.

* Promote digital adoption and effective use of in\-person, telephone and digital channels while preserving access to advice and support.

**At Chatters, beauty is more than what we do, it's how we connect, create, and build confidence every day. From professional hair services to must\-have beauty products, we bring passion and expertise together to create inspiring spaces where customers feel welcome, empowered, and excited to explore their personal style. We are seeing a Senior Director of Category Management \& Promotions to lead our team, drive strategic initiatives, and elevate our category and promotional strategies.**


**Position Overview**  

The **Senior Director, Category Management and Promotions** will lead the category management function to deliver profitable growth across retail, salon, ecommerce and franchise channels. This role is accountable for category strategy, assortment performance, promotional strategy, sales and gross margin delivery, vendor partnerships and inventory productivity. **Leading a team of four Category Managers and one Category Assistant**, the Senior Director will be responsible to translate business objectives and customer insights into clear category plans, compelling promotional activity and disciplined execution. This leader determines where to invest, expand, rationalize or exit, ensuring the assortment remains relevant, competitive and commercially productive.  

The Senior Director will work closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Ecommerce, Operations and Franchise Support to align priorities, resolve issues and deliver initiatives accurately and on time.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

**1\. Category Strategy \& Financial Performance**

* Own category sales and gross margin performance against plan, identifying risks early and implementing corrective actions.
* Lead annual and seasonal category plans that define growth opportunities, brand priorities, assortment direction and sales, margin and inventory objectives.
* Guide Category Managers in developing strategies grounded in customer needs, stylist insights, market trends, competitive activity and business performance.
* Evaluate category, brand and SKU productivity to guide investment, space allocation, assortment expansion and rationalization.

**2\. Assortment Strategy \& Planogram Execution*** Lead assortment decisions across channels and store formats, balancing customer demand, brand positioning, differentiation and profitability.
* Establish a disciplined approach to new brand and product evaluation, including business cases, launch plans and performance reviews.
* Oversee planogram strategy and reviews, ensuring product selection and space allocation reflect sales potential, margin contribution and inventory productivity.
* Ensure discontinued and underperforming products have timely exit plans that minimize markdowns, write\-offs and disruption to sales.

**3\. Inventory Productivity \& Product Lifecycle Management*** Partner with Supply Chain to align purchasing, forecasts, replenishment and inventory allocation with category plans and demand.
* Drive improvements in inventory turnover, sell\-through and working capital productivity while supporting strong product availability.
* Lead commercial action plans for excess, aging and discontinued inventory, including vendor returns, transfers, promotional support and markdown strategies.
* Anticipate inventory risks and coordinate actions to protect sales, margin and the customer experience.

**4\. Promotional Strategy \& Vendor Funding*** Establish promo schedule and events for the year to help meet sales and margin targets.
* Work with vendors to develop compelling events and negotiate funding, promotional allowances, gifts, exclusive offers and other support.
* Evaluate promotional opportunities for incremental sales, gross profit, inventory impact and customer value.
* Partner with Marketing and Ecommerce to align offers, featured products, messaging and channel execution.
* Ensure promotional commitments, forecasts, funding agreements and execution requirements are finalized within established deadlines.

**5\. Vendor Negotiation, Pricing \& Margin Management*** Negotiate commercial terms, cost changes, rebates, promotional funding, returns and other support that strengthen overall profitability.
* Challenge proposed cost increases and evaluate their impact on retail pricing, competitiveness, demand and margin.
* Guide pricing decisions across the assortment, balancing customer value, competitive positioning and financial objectives.
* Ensure vendor commitments are documented, communicated and fulfilled, with approved changes implemented accurately and on time.

**6\. Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Execution*** Serve as the central commercial partner connecting category priorities with Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Ecommerce, Operations and Franchise Support.
* Establish shared plans with clear deliverables, owners, dependencies and deadlines for promotions, launches, planograms and assortment changes.
* Resolve competing priorities and execution barriers, escalating decisions early when timelines or business results are at risk.

* Set clear objectives and hold the team accountable for business performance, quality of work and adherence to timelines.
* Establish consistent standards for category plans, vendor reviews, promotional analysis and performance reporting.
